description: MH-51 is the Deputy Regional Transport Office (Dy RTO) for Ichalkaranji, established in May 2023 to serve the major textile hub of Maharashtra. It was created to reduce the administrative burden on the main Kolhapur RTO (MH-09) and provides essential services like vehicle registration and licensing for the eastern parts of the district.
address: Deputy Regional Transport Office, Vikash Nagar, Ichalkaranji, Kolhapur District, Maharashtra
